== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Protocol Failure (Errata)]] (<code>1261_36</code>, Virtual Block 6.1 slip 37), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text. The Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-37-Protocol_Failure.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-protocolfailure-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Protocol Failure]]; the Master List (2013) prints the original too.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee forum, “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post p877234 by darkjediknight11, 16 April 2014 (Competitive Balance Team errata): https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p877234. Icons the post writes out are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on a site to cancel a Force drain there. Vader is deploy -1 here. At end of your turn If you control this site, place this Effect in Lost Pile. OR At any time, target a unique (•) [Episode I] droid. Opponent chooses: deploy on droid (its game text is canceled), or place this Effect in Lost Pile (you may ▲ any one card). [Immune to Control]”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 73) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1261_36</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, set mark, caption, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. The art window was re-fitted by hand (the Immediate Effect template drew a second type banner inside the art). Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-37-Protocol_Failure-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B38 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
